contract.words: Collect $15,000 of settled cash within 45 days using no up-front capital.

terms.proofCondition: Target settled cash received within the window

strategy.title: No executable plan: one hospital at $4,800 cannot carry $15,000
strategy.why: The single opening is one organisation (Meridian Regional Health System) whose evidenced price is one $4,800 purchase order already issued on 2026-10-02. Even if Meridian bought again, one buyer at $4,800 reaches at most a third of the $15,000 target; no population of similar buyers, and no conversion, is evidenced.

alternatives.title: Sell the credentialing audit workbook to Meridian
alternatives.why: At most $4,800 from one buyer; the PO was already awarded on 2026-10-02, so a further purchase is not evidenced; 30-day time to cash.

alternatives.title: Sell the same workbook to other hospital systems
alternatives.why: No counted population of hospitals buying this, no price paid by any other buyer, no conversion rate.

noPlan.decisiveGap: MARKET_VOLUME: the only buyer is one organisation whose single evidenced purchase is $4,800 (already awarded 2026-10-02); no population of buyers exists on the record to carry $15,000, so the target is out of reach even at a 100% close.
noPlan.resolution: Research a counted population of hospital systems procuring vendor-credentialing audits (published procurement portals/award notices with prices); at $4,800 per deal, at least 4 settled deals in 45 days are needed. Otherwise the owner lowers the target to what one buyer can carry.
